tagline: Improving where people live, work, and gather
hero_kpi_rationale: The Workplace Furnishings segment is HNI's primary growth driver, with a 14.6% increase in 2025, amplified by the strategic acquisition of Steelcase, a major office furniture player, positioning HNI as a consolidated leader in a transforming market.

kpis.name: Workplace Furnishings revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth of the Workplace Furnishings segment.
kpis.description: The Workplace Furnishings segment posted 14.6% growth in 2025, driven by Steelcase integration and resilient demand for office furniture solutions.
kpis.signal: Significant increase driven by Steelcase acquisition and office solutions demand.

kpis.name: Residential Building Products revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth of the Residential Building Products segment.
kpis.description: The Residential Building Products segment advanced 5.7% in 2025, despite challenging conditions related to interest rates and housing affordability.
kpis.signal: Growth despite a tight housing market.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved 50 basis points in 2025, thanks to better net productivity, despite accounting adjustments related to the Steelcase acquisition.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 4.4% in 2025 versus 8.2% in 2024, primarily due to Steelcase acquisition costs and restructuring charges.
kpis.signal: Margin compression related to acquisition costs.

kpis.name: Net sales
kpis.description: Net sales reached $2.839 billion in 2025, up 12.4%, driven by Steelcase acquisition ($187.5 million) and organic growth.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by acquisition and internal demand.

kpis.name: Steelcase acquisition costs
kpis.explanation: Costs associated with the Steelcase acquisition, including change-of-control compensation and transaction fees.
kpis.description: HNI recorded $94.6 million in costs related to the Steelcase acquisition, including change-of-control compensation and professional fees.
kpis.signal: Significant impact on net earnings in 2025.

kpis.name: Steelcase contribution to revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by Steelcase since its acquisition in December 2025.
kpis.description: Steelcase contributed $187.5 million to HNI's revenue since its acquisition on December 10, 2025.
kpis.signal: Successful integration of a key office furniture player since closing on December 10, 2025.

kpis.name: HNI India divestiture impact
kpis.explanation: Revenue reduction related to the divestiture of HNI India in Q2 2025.
kpis.description: The divestiture of HNI India in Q2 2025 reduced revenue by $16.2 million.
kpis.signal: Disengagement from a non-strategic business to focus on core strategies.

kpis.name: Workplace Furnishings revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth of the Workplace Furnishings segment.
kpis.description: The Workplace Furnishings segment posted 14.6% growth in 2025, driven by Steelcase integration and resilient demand for office furniture solutions.
kpis.signal: Significant increase driven by Steelcase acquisition and office solutions demand.

kpis.name: Residential Building Products revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth of the Residential Building Products segment.
kpis.description: The Residential Building Products segment advanced 5.7% in 2025, despite challenging conditions related to interest rates and housing affordability.
kpis.signal: Growth despite a tight housing market.

risks.title: Successful Steelcase integration
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited at the top of risk factors in connection with a transformational $1.9 billion acquisition. The language emphasizes existential elements: transformational, strong foundation. The Industrial category is heavily weighted here. New risk compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Increased debt post-acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Borrowings for the Steelcase acquisition raised net interest expenses from $27.2 million to $35.6 million. The document explicitly mentions risks related to repayment capacity and financial covenants. High-impact Capital category.

risks.title: Rate volatility and affordability
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of the Residential Building Products segment, with strong language: difficult dynamics, volatility. Direct impact on demand. Present both years, but accentuated in 2025.

risks.title: Unrealized synergies
risks.score_rationale: The document projects cost savings synergies but specifies that accretion will be modest in 2026. The risk is implicit but critical, with direct impact on future profitability. Industrial category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Government tariff policies
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of increased uncertainty, but without detail on concrete impact. Moderate language: elevated level of uncertainty. Already present last year.

risks.title: HNI India divestiture
risks.score_rationale: The disengagement is presented as strategic, but results in a $6.5 million loss and a $16.2 million sales decline. Measurable but limited impact. Industrial category, moderate weighting.

risks.title: Pressure on operating margins
risks.score_rationale: Operating margin declined from 8.2% to 4.4% in one year. The document cites cost-price pressures and elevated SG&A expenses. Factual but concerning language. Implicitly present each year.

ai_positioning.summary: HNI Corporation did not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its filed documents. The company does not appear to communicate an active strategy or use of these technologies.
